rule.directionally_robust: all 20 point estimates are above zero but at least one simultaneous lower bound includes zero
rule.no_adaptive_extension: No extra NFE, sampler seed, checkpoint or contrast may be added after results are visible.
rule.primary_metric: legacy foreground MSE on all registered records
rule.robust_ci_clean: all 20 expected-direction point estimates and simultaneous 95% lower bounds are above zero
rule.sensitive: one or more registered point estimates are zero or negative
